name: get_observation
description: Get current observation: RGB/depth images from agentview and wrist cameras, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, robot joint positions, and end-effector cartesian pose.
code:
# Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: get_observation() -> dict
# Keys: ['agentview']['images']['rgb'|'depth'], ['agentview']['intrinsics'] (3,3), ['agentview']['pose_mat'] (4,4),
#        ['robot0_eye_in_hand']['images']['rgb'|'depth'], ['robot0_eye_in_hand']['intrinsics'], ['robot0_eye_in_hand']['pose_mat'],
#        ['robot_joint_pos'] (7,), ['robot_cartesian_pos'] (8,: xyz + wxyz + gripper)

name: segment_sam3_text_prompt
description: Run SAM3 segmentation on an RGB image conditioned on a text prompt. Returns list of dicts with 'mask' (H,W bool), 'box' [x1,y1,x2,y2], 'score' float. Returns empty list if nothing found.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb: ndarray(H,W,3), text_prompt: str) -> list[dict]

name: segment_sam3_point_prompt
description: Run SAM3 segmentation on an RGB image conditioned on a pixel coordinate point prompt. Returns list of dicts with 'mask' (H,W bool) and 'score' float.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: segment_sam3_point_prompt(rgb: ndarray(H,W,3), point_coords: tuple(x,y)) -> list[dict]

name: point_prompt_molmo
description: Use Molmo VLM to locate objects in an image given a text description. Returns dict mapping object name to (x, y) pixel coordinates; (None, None) if parsing failed.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: point_prompt_molmo(image: ndarray(H,W,3), text_prompt: str) -> dict[str, tuple]

name: plan_grasp
description: Plan grasp candidates using Contact-GraspNet from a single depth image + segmentation mask. Returns (grasp_poses (K,4,4) in CAMERA frame, grasp_scores (K,)). Caller must transform to world frame using camera extrinsics.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: plan_grasp(depth: ndarray(H,W), intrinsics: ndarray(3,3), segmentation: ndarray(H,W)) -> tuple[ndarray(K,4,4), ndarray(K,)]

name: plan_grasp_from_point_clouds
description: Plan grasp candidates using Contact-GraspNet from full scene point cloud + segmented object point cloud (both in world frame, from multiple viewpoints). Returns (grasp_poses (K,4,4) in point cloud frame, grasp_scores (K,)).
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: plan_grasp_from_point_clouds(pc_full: ndarray(N,3), pc_segment: ndarray(M,3)) -> tuple[ndarray(K,4,4), ndarray(K,)]

name: get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points
description: Compute oriented bounding box (OBB) from 3D points. Returns dict with 'center' (3,), 'extent' (3,), 'R' (3,3) rotation matrix.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points(points: ndarray(N,3)) -> dict

name: solve_ik
description: Solve inverse kinematics for panda_hand link. Returns 7-DOF joint angles. Has automatic orientation fallbacks if requested orientation is unreachable.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: solve_ik(position: ndarray(3,), quaternion_wxyz: ndarray(4,)) -> ndarray(7,)

name: move_to_joints
description: Move the robot to a given 7-DOF joint configuration in a blocking manner. Keep pre-grasp cartesian offsets small (e.g. 0.075m) for smooth interpolation.
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: move_to_joints(joints: ndarray(7,)) -> None

name: goto_pose
description: Move end-effector to target pose using IK. Combines solve_ik + move_to_joints. Optional z_approach for pre-grasp approach motion (moves to position+z_approach in Z first, then descends).
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: goto_pose(position: ndarray(3,), quaternion_wxyz: ndarray(4,), z_approach: float = 0.0) -> None

name: normalize_vector

name: verify_object_identity
description: Second-look VLM verification that a localized pixel actually shows the expected object. Use BEFORE grasping when the scene contains visually similar items (e.g. cream cheese vs milk vs butter, chocolate pudding vs orange sauce). Crops a region around the candidate pixel and asks an LLM with vision whether it matches the expected object name. Returns {verified, confidence, actual, reasoning}.
code:
# Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: verify_object_identity(rgb: ndarray, target_pixel: tuple[int,int], expected_object: str, crop_radius: int = 60) -> dict
# Returns dict with keys 'verified' (bool), 'confidence' (float 0-1), 'actual' (str), 'reasoning' (str).
# Use it after Molmo/SAM3 returns a candidate pixel and BEFORE plan_grasp / goto_pose to detect mis-localized objects.

name: inspect_at_wrist
description: Active perception: move the wrist camera 10cm above a 3D target and return the close-up RGB+depth view. Use AFTER an initial agent-view localization when the scene is cluttered or the target is visually similar to neighbours (cream cheese vs milk, butter vs other packages). The wrist close-up is much sharper than the static agent-view and you can re-segment / re-prompt Molmo on it before grasping.
code:
# Built-in Franka LIBERO primitive: inspect_at_wrist(target_world_pos: ndarray(3,), hover_height: float = 0.10) -> dict
# Returns {'ok': bool, 'moved_to': ndarray(3,), 'wrist': {'rgb','depth','images','intrinsics','pose_mat'}, 'agentview': {...}}
# Wrist rgb is the close-up and can be read as close['wrist']['rgb'] or close['wrist']['images']['rgb'].
# Re-run segment_sam3_text_prompt on the wrist rgb to confirm identity before grasping.

name: select_top_down_grasp
description: Select the best grasp that aligns the gripper vertically (top-down) from grasp candidates in camera frame. Returns (best_grasp_world_matrix (4,4), best_score) or (None, -inf).
code: # Built-in Franka LIBERO skill library: select_top_down_grasp(grasps: ndarray(N,4,4), scores: ndarray(N,), cam_to_world: ndarray(4,4), vertical_threshold: float = 0.8) -> tuple[ndarray(4,4) | None, float]
